title: Nomad: Autonomous Exploration and Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2603.29353v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Nomad, a system for autonomous data exploration and insight discovery. Given a corpus of documents, databases, or other data sources, users rarely know the full set of questions, hypotheses, or connections that could be explored. As a result, query-driven question answering and prompt-driven deep-research systems remain limited by human framing and often fail to cover the broader insight space. Nomad addresses this problem with an exploration-first architecture. It constructs an explicit Exploration Map over the domain and systematically traverses it to balance breadth and depth. It generates and selects hypotheses and investigates them with an explorer agent that can use document search, web search, and database tools. Candidate insights are then checked by an independent verifier before entering a reporting pipeline that produces cited reports and higher-level meta-reports. translated_title: 游牧者：自主探索与发现
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了Nomad，一个用于自主数据探索和洞察发现的系统。给定一个文档、数据库或其他数据源的集合，用户通常不知道可以探索的全部问题、假设或联系。因此，基于查询的问答和基于提示的深度研究系统仍然受到人类框架的限制，往往无法覆盖更广泛的洞察空间。Nomad通过一种探索优先的架构解决了这个问题。它在领域上构建一个显式的探索地图，并系统地遍历它以平衡广度和深度。它生成并选择假设，并通过一个探索代理进行调查，该代理可以使用文档搜索、网络搜索和数据库工具。候选洞察在进入报告管道之前由独立的验证器检查，该管道生成带引用的报告和更高级别的元报告。我们还提供了一个全面的评估框架。
tldr: Nomad通过探索优先的架构和显式探索地图，自主生成并验证假设，克服了传统查询驱动系统在覆盖广泛洞察空间方面的局限性。
en_tdlr: Nomad overcomes the limitations of query-driven systems in covering broad insight spaces by using an exploration-first architecture with an explicit exploration map to autonomously generate and verify hypotheses.
